product_launches.description: Fictiv launched its Instant Injection Molding Quotes capability, offering automated 24/7 cost and lead-time estimates for qualifying injection molding designs through its digital manufacturing platform.

press_references.value: Fictiv 2025 Year in Review: Building the Future of Manufacturing

product_launches.description: Fictiv launched multiple new digital manufacturing platform capabilities, including AI-powered configuration tools, a centralized Parts Library, advanced injection molding DFM, customs workflow, and mold fabrication reporting.

Fictiv has launched significant new features and upgrades to its injection molding service, including advanced DFM tools, mold flow simulation integration, and enhanced mold build visibility, aiming to improve customer experience and manufacturing outcomes.

press_references.value: Fictiv Launches Large-Scale CNC Parts Manufacturing

product_launches.description: Fictiv launched its Large Part CNC Machining Services, enabling production of custom CNC parts up to 34 feet long with industry-leading tolerances and fast turnaround times, targeting industries such as aerospace, robotics, and energy generation.

press_references.value: Fictiv Launches Production Manufacturing & Supply Chain Solutions to Navigate Tariff Challenges

product_launches.description: An AI-driven platform offering end-to-end manufacturing and supply chain solutions, including design guidance, supplier selection, and logistics optimization.

overview_description.description: Fictiv is the operating system (OS) for custom manufacturing that makes it faster, easier, and more efficient to source and supply mechanical parts. Their platform helps to source custom mechanical components and offers various manufacturing services, including 3D printing, CNC machining, and injection molding. They connect businesses with a global network of manufacturing partners to streamline the process of sourcing and producing parts, aiming to accelerate time to market and reduce costs.

about_short_description.short_description: Fictiv is a digital manufacturing and supply chain company that offers a digital platform for sourcing custom mechanical components.

product.name: Fictiv Digital Manufacturing Platform
product.description: A digital platform for uploading CAD files, obtaining instant quotes, receiving design-for-manufacturability feedback, placing orders, and tracking custom-part production through delivery.

product.name: Custom Manufacturing Services
product.description: On-demand production of custom mechanical parts for prototypes, new product introduction, low-volume runs, and full-scale production using a managed global supplier network.

product.name: CNC Machining Services
product.description: CNC machining for precision metal and plastic parts, including tight-tolerance components, surface finishing, and production quantities from prototypes to scale.

product.name: 3D Printing Services
product.description: Industrial 3D printing for rapid prototypes, functional parts, and low-volume components using FDM, SLS, SLA, PolyJet, and MJF processes.

product.name: Injection Molding Services
product.description: Production-grade injection molding for plastic prototypes and end-use parts, including low-volume tooling, T1 samples, and secondary operations.

product.name: Sheet Metal Services
product.description: Custom sheet-metal fabrication for formed and finished parts such as enclosures, panels, brackets, and structural components.
